title: Add implementation completeness gate
description:
Implement a gate that triggers when the agent has read all related files and no code changes are made. The gate should prompt the agent to explicitly verify if the existing implementation meets all ticket requirements before calling implementation_done. This prevents agents from getting stuck in read-only loops when the work is already done.
